source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Related command variants were searched and do not replace this coverage.

source_snapshot.master: Master inconsistently mentions an interface selector although OOB command has no request byte, accepts success only, and clears logs.
source_snapshot.comparison: Exact-row DeepSeek and GPT V2 were checked against Master semantics.

historical_reviews.history: Neighboring records and target-specific semantics checked.

original_test_intent: Read vendor OEM BMC, BIOS, system-FPGA and HIB-FPGA revisions and compare each component with Project SPEC.
original_method: Original Master source is retained verbatim; Review adds a safe bounded method.
manual_activity: Project supplies the applicable vendor 0x30/0x20 response contract and expected version matrix.
agent_execution_scope: Run only the bounded approved command
engineer_actions: Approve inputs, limits and recovery; own DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not accepted blindly; missing fields, credential handling and semantic coverage were corrected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Issue vendor-approved 0x30/0x20 with the documented empty request, decode each version field, and compare component-by-component.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Original fields/timing are preserved and absent bytes are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Issue vendor-approved 0x30/0x20 with the documented empty request, decode each version field, and compare component-by-component.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects execution and acceptance only in Review.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Correct version bytes do not validate firmware update or every image region.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OEM layouts can vary by platform and may mislabel components.

project_override_considerations: Alternate tools are allowed only with approved equivalence and explicit disclosure of unverified original-tool/raw-command coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master inconsistently mentions an interface selector although OOB command has no request byte, accepts success only, and clears logs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core operation is identifiable; target values and approval are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Turns an exit-code check into target-qualified multi-component version validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: OEM NetFn payloads are not portable. The case must first bind the byte layout to this platform, then keep BMC, BIOS, system FPGA and HIB FPGA identities separate; a plausible byte string or a high-level version cannot establish all four.
